note: Golden wire contract for the community space-ID door's presented-credential path (ADR 0226 fallback ruling 2026-09-18; idss #1608). matou-app #534 copies THIS file so neither side guesses the wire shapes. challenge_id / expires_at / response / presentation values are illustrative placeholders; the fields, codes, statuses and messages are the contract. Snake_case on the wire (idss API convention); matou-app reads the recorded IDs BACK from the descriptor's anysync block under its own camelCase keys.

body.message: this community's spaces are already recorded — re-read the descriptor and join them

not_operator.when: the credential verifies but carries role: member, or the roster no longer holds the verified AID as a live operator

body.message: only a steward can do this — ask one of your community's stewards

credential_rejected.when: the challenge is stale/spent/signed over another door, or the credential is revoked, tampered, from an untrusted issuer, or somebody else's — the message is the verifier's own member-facing sentence (this example: a stale/wrong-address challenge)

body.message: that sign-in request has expired or the signature did not match your identity

records_unreachable.when: the community's witnessed ledger cannot be read — fail closed, nothing recorded, no verdict cached (ADR 0236 §4)

body.message: the community's records can't be reached right now — try again shortly
